risks: Destination-only create under a writer lease is collision-safe but does not atomically assert the reviewed source; a separate read-before-copy still permits changed-source acceptance.
Hardcoded native epoch 1 and separate descriptor transaction cannot fence an inPlace authority switch; adoptDescriptor intentionally refuses that migration.
